composition: Native vertical 1024x1536 phone wallpaper. Design the full tall canvas with convincing depth, elegant leading lines and a strongly resolved focal scene in the middle and lower areas. Leave the upper roughly 20% naturally quiet for a lock-screen clock, using open sky, mist, water, a wall or a gentle color field; do not draw any clock or UI. Do not put essential faces or details at the extreme sides. Use a full-bleed rectangular composition, no border, no circular frame. creative_direction: Arrange one lilac orchid stem in a low clear-glass vessel, letting it arc gently across the middle without filling the frame. The nearest flower has delicate translucent edges, while a few pale roots remain visible through the water. Broad window light creates soft blue reflections on warm white. Keep all surfaces unmarked and the setting quietly refined. Vertical 1024x1536. Reserve the upper twenty percent as naturally quiet negative space, keeping detail lower in the composition. Original peaceful image, no text, branding, or watermark.
